hooks.command: sed -n 's/.*"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.kt) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; command -v ktlint >/dev/null || exit 0; ktlint --format "$f"; }

sed -n 's/.*"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.java) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; case "$f" in "$PWD"/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; [ -x ./gradlew ] || exit 0; ./gradlew --quiet javafmtFix; }
